notes: Piece counts match the parts list: 69 pieces over 22 lines.

Booklet gives no coordinates, so the layout is inferred. The two 4x10 plates sit side by side (8x10) and are not stacked, so b1 and b2 clutch nothing. The four black 1x8 tiles frame the base, with the printed tile at the front. The two grey 4x6 plates cover the middle. The four grey 1x6 tiles ring them.
Step 5 and 6 fill-in: the 2x2 plate (b15) carries the round-plate stack. The two 1x2 tiles are flush in the back-left. Eight jumpers fill the right side, and the brick tower stands on them.
Tower layers are staggered as 1x3 / 2x3 / 1x3 bricks over 2x3 bricks. Which exact brick sits on which jumper is my best reading of the pictures.
Round stack: each 1x1 round plate (6141) goes under a 2x2 round plate and presses into its axle hole. Each unit then sits on the plate below. The 2x2 round tile (b37) caps the stack.

Step 18 top: I read it as black, white, then black 1x3 plates. A black 1x1 plate carries the black 1x1 tile on the middle stud, and the two antennas stand on the end studs. The pictures could also be read with the white plate at a different level. Piece counts are unaffected.
Parts-list colours were used instead of the dark render shading in the booklet. The 19 jumper plates are Black and have no element number in the list.
